info.title: TenkaCloud Simulator API
info.description:
Sign in through the local console first. The browser sends its same-origin session cookie; Test Request uses that session. For curl or SDKs add the host-issued `X-Simulator-Token` header. Dummy TCSIM signature credentials identify the AWS wire format; they are not host authentication. `x-simulator-principal` selects an exercise identity only. Participant sessions are already bound to an identity and cannot select simulator-admin. Never enter real AWS credentials here. 

**Examples are static documentation, not saved state.** Use Test Request → Send to query your environment. S3 responses remain native XML/bytes; expand typed schemas below to understand fields.

Independent local cloud simulator. AWS is the first provider, with documented S3, Systems Manager Parameter Store, SQS, Lambda, CloudFormation and IAM role subsets. No real infrastructure is created. This document describes only implemented operations. S3 wire APIs retain their XML formats; Native IAM roles use Query/XML; legacy identity control remains a separate JSON API. Native role ownership blocks legacy PUT/DELETE with HTTP409. Use unsigned requests or dummy TCSIM SDK credentials. Default principal simulator-admin has full sandbox access. IAM Query routing uses X-Simulator-Service: iam (or the dummy SDK signature scope), root POST and Version2010-05-08. Nine bounded role/inline-policy operations are implemented; no STS, managed policies, Conditions or non-root paths. Native Lambda roles must trust lambda.amazonaws.com. Legacy CFN/local identity roles retain their prior metadata-only trust semantics. For IAM exercises send x-simulator-principal. SQLite is ephemeral by default; --state persists it. See /_simulator/v1/capabilities for limits and deviations. Lambda supports a bounded Python 3.12 ZIP subset through the native REST paths below. Host Python is not required. A limited saved-role local SSM/S3 function SDK is supported; arbitrary network/HTTP and Function URLs remain unsupported. CloudFormation supports inline Python AWS::Lambda::Function with index.handler, existing local role, Ref/Arn and explicit DependsOn. Caller requires Lambda Create/DeleteFunction and iam:PassRole; tagged creation also requires lambda:TagResource. Only the declared saved-role SSM/S3 capability bridge is available, with no arbitrary network or managed-policy grants. Function SDK limits: S3 object body32KiB, native response48KiB before capability encoding, message64KiB,128calls and1MiB request/response aggregate. Oversized native SSM or S3 responses return EntityTooLarge without a partial successful result. API Gateway REST APIs support an explicit REGIONAL/NONE/Lambda AWS_PROXY subset. Deployments freeze resources and integrations; stages refer to a deployment. No public endpoint or real AWS is created. Local invocation requires the host access token/session and a bounded Lambda apigateway.amazonaws.com resource permission with a matching local execute-api SourceArn. Responses are non-executing downloads, with protected cookie/navigation/CORS/CSP headers removed. Active browser app hosting, WAF, custom domains, authorizers, binary media, API keys, caching, stage editing and full WP grading remain unsupported. CloudFormation also provisions the bounded RestApi/Resource/Method/Deployment/Stage and Lambda::Permission subset in the same native SQLite transaction. Deployment DependsOn methods is explicit; API children are same-stack, snapshots immutable, and native drift blocks destructive cleanup. No WAF or custom resources are supported.

**Static examples below are sample documentation, not your current state.** Click **Test Request**, then **Send** to execute this operation. The client shows the live HTTP status, headers and body. Lists the buckets currently saved in this environment, across the supported regions. `Buckets/Bucket/Name` is a bucket name; `BucketRegion` is its saved region; `CreationDate` is UTC. An actually executed response with `<Buckets></Buckets>` is empty. The example below intentionally contains two sample buckets. Requires `s3:ListAllMyBuckets` on `*`.

**Local access:** browser requests use your signed-in simulator session. curl/SDK clients need the host-issued X-Simulator-Token. Dummy AWS signature keys are not login credentials. A host 401 means sign in again; an IAM 403 means the current exercise identity lacks permission.

After a live S3 metadata request, use the **Live S3 result · Read fields** button or **Alt+Shift+R** for a bounded field explanation. The API client keeps the original XML. The explanation is not available for arbitrary object bodies.

post.summary: SSM/SQS JSON, CloudFormation Query, or IAM Query operation
post.description:
**Static request templates:** choose the correct Content-Type and routing headers before Test Request → Send. SSM/SQS send JSON with X-Amz-Target (JSON 1.1 for SSM, JSON 1.0 for SQS); CloudFormation/IAM send URL-encoded Query fields. The 200 response is JSON for SSM/SQS and XML for Query protocols. A successful DeleteStack has no result payload beyond Query response metadata.

Native regional root endpoint. SQS: X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.CreateQueue, ListQueues, GetQueueUrl, DeleteQueue, SendMessage, ReceiveMessage, DeleteMessage, ChangeMessageVisibility, GetQueueAttributes (JSON 1.0, Standard queues only; local body limit 256 KiB, aggregate physical storage 10000 messages/64 MiB across queues/regions including expired foreign rows until scoped cleanup; bytes count body UTF-8 plus stored attribute JSON. Over-budget SendMessage returns local SimulatorQuotaExceeded without mutation; existing over-cap data remains readable/deletable; FIFO, Query protocol, batch operations and dead-letter redrive are unsupported). SSM: X-Amz-Target AmazonSSM.PutParameter, GetParameter, GetParameters, GetParametersByPath, DescribeParameters, DeleteParameter. CloudFormation: CreateStack, DescribeStacks, DeleteStack; S3 buckets, SSM parameters, inline Python Lambda functions, one inline IAM identity policy per role, five Regional REST API Gateway resource types, and bounded Lambda::Permission. Unsupported options fail. Real credentials and session tokens are rejected. Create/DeleteStack also require the caller to allow the underlying S3/SSM/IAM/Lambda actions; CAPABILITY_IAM grants no permissions. API resources use NONE/POST AWS_PROXY local Lambda, same-stack API children, explicit deployment DependsOn methods and reverse guarded cleanup. Lambda permission uses only apigateway.amazonaws.com and local execute-api SourceArn. No service RoleArn or general CloudFormation lifecycle is supported. IAM is global: send X-Simulator-Service: iam, Version2010-05-08 and one of CreateRole/GetRole/ListRoles/DeleteRole/PutRolePolicy/GetRolePolicy/DeleteRolePolicy/ListRolePolicies/UpdateAssumeRolePolicy. Policy documents are JSON strings; successful IAM XML returns them RFC3986 URL-encoded. Native role names use the local alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen subset,1–64; inline policy names1–128 AWS characters. Trust and aggregate policies32KiB, at most10 inline policies/100 statements,1000 active+retired name claims. Deleted role names cannot be adopted by legacy identity writes. No managed grants or session issuance.

**Local access:** browser requests use your signed-in simulator session. curl/SDK clients need the host-issued X-Simulator-Token. Dummy AWS signature keys are not login credentials. A host 401 means sign in again; an IAM 403 means the current exercise identity lacks permission.

put.description:
**Static examples below are sample documentation, not your current state.** Click **Test Request**, then **Send** to execute this operation. The client shows the live HTTP status, headers and body. Requires s3:CreateBucket on the bucket ARN. Empty body creates in us-east-1. Other supported regions require LocationConstraint. Bucket subresources: use ?versioning for Get/PutBucketVersioning; ?publicAccessBlock for Get/Put/DeletePublicAccessBlock; ?versions for GET ListObjectVersions. Do not combine subresources or send list-type with them. Versioning Status is Enabled/Suspended; MFA Delete is unsupported. Public access block stores the four bucket-level booleans; public ACLs/policies remain unsupported. Bucket tags use ?tagging. GET requires s3:GetBucketTagging; PUT/DELETE require s3:PutBucketTagging. User-defined metadata only, no ABAC/billing/system tags. An empty replacement removes the set; an absent set returns NoSuchTagSet.

get.summary: List objects, versions or bucket settings
get.description:
**Static examples below are sample documentation, not your current state.** Click **Test Request**, then **Send** to execute this operation. The client shows the live HTTP status, headers and body. Choose **one** query mode. Do not combine selectors.

| Goal | Query | XML root / what it means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Current objects | `?list-type=2` (default) | `ListBucketResult`: `Contents/Key` is an object key, `Size` is bytes, `KeyCount` is this page's entries. |
| Retained versions | `?versions` | `ListVersionsResult`: `Version` contains saved bodies; `DeleteMarker` hides a key without erasing old versions. |
| Bucket region | `?location` | `LocationConstraint`: empty text means `us-east-1`. |
| Versioning setting | `?versioning` | `VersioningConfiguration`: missing `Status` means never enabled. |
| Public-access settings | `?publicAccessBlock` | `PublicAccessBlockConfiguration`: four saved booleans. |
| User tags | `?tagging` | `Tagging/TagSet/Tag`: `Key` and `Value` pairs. |

For any setting/history mode, **remove `list-type=2`** and unrelated query fields in the request editor before Send. A 404 setting/tag error means that configuration is absent, not necessarily that the bucket is absent. Requires the corresponding S3 read action; this simulator rejects unsupported selectors, combined selectors and nonempty selector values. `ListBucketResult` is not a bucket list.

**Local access:** browser requests use your signed-in simulator session. curl/SDK clients need the host-issued X-Simulator-Token. Dummy AWS signature keys are not login credentials. A host 401 means sign in again; an IAM 403 means the current exercise identity lacks permission.

After a live S3 metadata request, use the **Live S3 result · Read fields** button or **Alt+Shift+R** for a bounded field explanation. The API client keeps the original XML. The explanation is not available for arbitrary object bodies.

get.description:
Local simulator-only transport, not an AWS public URL. No IAM management grant is added by this call. The deployed NONE method still requires local host token/session authentication and the function resource policy must grant this exact service SourceArn. Lambda runs with its saved execution role. UTF-8 body/event/output maximum256KiB, integration deadline29seconds. Response status/body are preserved, but data is forced to application/octet-stream attachment with restrictive CSP; Set-Cookie, Location, CORS and simulator authority headers are removed. Browser application hosting remains unavailable.

**Local access:** browser requests use your signed-in simulator session. curl/SDK clients need the host-issued X-Simulator-Token. Dummy AWS signature keys are not login credentials. A host 401 means sign in again; an IAM 403 means the current exercise identity lacks permission.

No public/cross-account grants, qualifiers, Function URLs or other service principals. IAM lambda:AddPermission on the function ARN is enforced. Deleting the function removes its policy; recreating the name cannot inherit grants.

**Local access:** browser requests use your signed-in simulator session. curl/SDK clients need the host-issued X-Simulator-Token. Dummy AWS signature keys are not login credentials. A host 401 means sign in again; an IAM 403 means the current exercise identity lacks permission.

S3Bucket.title: Bucket
S3Bucket.description: One bucket stored in this simulator environment.

Name.description: Bucket name. Use this value as {bucket} in subsequent requests.

CreationDate.description: UTC timestamp when the bucket was created.

BucketRegion.description: The region saved for this bucket; not a separate AWS account.

S3BucketList.title: ListAllMyBucketsResult
S3BucketList.description: Live GET / returns the buckets currently stored in this environment. Static examples below are sample data, not a query of your state.

Buckets.description: Zero or more Bucket elements. An empty Buckets element means this response contains no buckets.

S3ObjectSummary.title: Contents
S3ObjectSummary.description: One current object. This is metadata; GET /{bucket}/{key} downloads its actual bytes.

Key.description: Full object key; slashes are part of the key, not real folders.

ETag.description: Quoted entity tag used by conditional requests; not an object ID.

Size.description: Object length in bytes, not a count of objects.

StorageClass.description: The simulator returns STANDARD; other storage classes are unsupported.

S3CommonPrefix.title: CommonPrefixes
S3CommonPrefix.description: A grouping produced by delimiter=/, not a separately stored folder.

Prefix.description: Common key prefix, for example photos/.

S3ObjectList.title: ListBucketResult
S3ObjectList.description: Result for GET /{bucket}?list-type=2. Contents lists current objects, not buckets or old versions.

Prefix.description: Only keys starting with this prefix were considered.

MaxKeys.description: Requested maximum number of objects and common-prefix groups on this page.

KeyCount.description: Number of returned object/prefix entries on this page; not the total bucket size.

IsTruncated.description: true means another page exists. Keep the same prefix/delimiter and send NextContinuationToken as continuation-token.

ContinuationToken.description: Opaque cursor supplied in the request, when present.

NextContinuationToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Omitted when IsTruncated is false.

StartAfter.description: Exclusive starting key, if supplied; cannot be combined with continuation-token.

EncodingType.description: url when keys/prefixes are percent-encoded by encoding-type=url.

Contents.description: Repeated Contents elements, one per current object. Omitted when no current objects match.

CommonPrefixes.description: Repeated prefix groups when a delimiter was requested.

S3Location.title: LocationConstraint
S3Location.description: Bucket region. Empty text means us-east-1, following the S3 GetBucketLocation convention.

S3Versioning.title: VersioningConfiguration
S3Versioning.description: Saved bucket versioning setting. Empty configuration means versioning has never been enabled; it does not mean the bucket is missing.

Status.description: Enabled retains new versions; Suspended writes a null version while retaining older history. Omitted for an unversioned bucket.

S3PublicAccessBlock.title: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration
S3PublicAccessBlock.description: Four saved bucket-level settings. These do not add support for public ACLs or bucket policies.

BlockPublicAcls.description: Stores the block-public-ACLs setting. ACL operations are unsupported.

BlockPublicPolicy.description: Stores the block-public-policy setting. Bucket policies are unsupported.

S3Tag.title: Tag
S3Tag.description: One user-defined bucket tag; not an IAM permission or billing integration.

Key.description: Unique tag key; 1–128 Unicode characters. aws: prefixes are reserved.

Value.description: Tag value; up to 256 Unicode characters. Empty values are allowed.

S3Tagging.title: Tagging
S3Tagging.description: Saved user tags for one bucket. An absent tag set produces NoSuchTagSet, not an empty successful result.

TagSet.description: Repeated Tag elements; at most 50 keys.

VersionId.description: Opaque saved version identifier; null denotes the unversioned/null version.

IsLatest.description: Whether this item is the most recent version or delete marker for this key.

LastModified.description: UTC time this version or marker was created.

ETag.description: Quoted entity tag; only on object versions.

Size.description: Object bytes; only on object versions.

S3DeleteMarker.title: DeleteMarker
S3DeleteMarker.description: A deletion marker; it has no object body, ETag or Size.

VersionId.description: Opaque saved version identifier; null denotes the unversioned/null version.

IsLatest.description: Whether this item is the most recent version or delete marker for this key.

LastModified.description: UTC time this version or marker was created.

S3Versions.title: ListVersionsResult
S3Versions.description: History for GET /{bucket}?versions. This differs from list-type=2, which shows only currently visible objects.

KeyMarker.description: Requested starting key; empty on the first page.

NextKeyMarker.description: Next key cursor, present when more results remain.

NextVersionIdMarker.description: Next version cursor. Send together with NextKeyMarker.

IsTruncated.description: true means more retained versions/markers remain.

Version.description: Retained object versions, not just the current body.

DeleteMarker.description: Deletion markers. These can make an object appear absent while old versions remain.

CommonPrefixes.description: Grouped key prefixes when delimiter is supplied.

S3Error.title: Error
S3Error.description: Native S3 failure. Code identifies the error; Message explains the cause; Resource is the requested path. HEAD responses have no body.

Code.description: Machine-readable S3 error code. Use this value, not HTTP status alone, to identify the problem.

Message.example: The specified bucket does not exist.

Resource.description: The requested bucket/object path, when present.

RequestId.description: Local request identifier; not an AWS request ID.

type.description: Only local Lambda proxy integrations are implemented.

httpMethod.description: Integration method used to invoke Lambda, independent of the client request method.

uri.description: Unqualified same-region/account Lambda invocation URI. This is configuration, not a public application URL.

authorizationType.description: NONE means no API Gateway IAM authorizer. Host token/session access and Lambda service permission are still required.

apiKeyRequired.description: Always false; API keys and usage plans are unsupported.

requestParameters.description: Only the documented required greedy-proxy path binding is supported.

name.description: API display name; not its identifier.

createdDate.description: Native wire timestamp as Unix seconds, not an ISO date string.

rootResourceId.description: Identifier of the root / resource, needed before creating child resources/methods.

id.description: Resource identifier used in method paths.

parentId.description: Parent resource ID; omitted on the root resource.

pathPart.description: One path segment, or the supported greedy {proxy+}; omitted on the root.

path.description: Full resource template, which may differ from a concrete request path.

resourceMethods.description: Methods currently saved on this resource.

id.description: Identifier of the immutable saved snapshot.

stageName.description: Stage name used in the local execute-api path.

deploymentId.description: Immutable snapshot this stage executes; later method edits do not change the snapshot.

variables.description: Saved stage variables; not host environment variables or credentials.

item.description: Native JSON uses singular item. boto3 normalizes this to items.

position.description: Opaque pagination cursor, omitted on the last page.

item.description: Native JSON uses singular item. boto3 normalizes this to items.

position.description: Opaque pagination cursor, omitted on the last page.

Statement.description: JSON-encoded policy statement. Decode the string as JSON to read its Sid/Principal/SourceArn; it is not a nested response object.

Policy.description: JSON-encoded function resource policy, not the execution-role identity policy.

RevisionId.description: Opaque current revision; supply when changing/removing a permission to detect stale writes.

message.description: Native operation explanation. Error type is also sent in x-amzn-ErrorType; inspect both status and message.

error.description: Host authentication failure, before the cloud protocol handler runs.

LocationConstraint.description: Region for a newly created bucket. Omit the entire body for the usual us-east-1 creation.

S3VersioningInput.title: VersioningConfiguration
S3VersioningInput.description: PUT ?versioning requires Status Enabled or Suspended; empty configuration is only a possible GET response.

Status.description: Enabled retains new versions; Suspended writes a null version while retaining older history. Omitted for an unversioned bucket.

S3PublicAccessBlockInput.title: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration
S3PublicAccessBlockInput.description: PUT ?publicAccessBlock replaces saved flags. Omitted flags become false; these settings do not implement ACLs/policies.

BlockPublicAcls.description: Stores the block-public-ACLs setting. ACL operations are unsupported.

BlockPublicPolicy.description: Stores the block-public-policy setting. Bucket policies are unsupported.

HostAccessRequired.description: The local host did not accept a simulator token/session. Sign in again or supply the host-issued X-Simulator-Token. Dummy AWS keys and x-simulator-principal do not authenticate.
